items.raw_excerpt: "Friend-for-hire" services have started taking off in Thailand as the country's social landscape changes with an aging population and a rise in the number of unmarried people.
items.summary_en: Friend-for-hire services are gaining traction in Thailand. The trend reflects changing social dynamics as the population ages and more people remain unmarried.
items.summary_ko: 태국에서 대여 친구 서비스가 주목받고 있다. 고령화와 미혼 인구 증가로 사회적 변화가 일면서 이 같은 서비스가 빠르게 확산되고 있다.
items.title_en: Friend-for-hire services grow popular in Thailand
items.title_ko: 태국에서 대여 친구 서비스 인기 확산
items.title_original: Friend-for-hire services gain traction in Thailand

items.raw_excerpt: ANZ is considering closing its Dunedin contact centre and moving jobs to offices in other parts of the country.
items.summary_en: ANZ is thinking about closing its contact centre in Dunedin. The jobs would move to offices in other parts of New Zealand. This would affect local workers.
items.summary_ko: ANZ가 더니든에 있는 고객센터 폐쇄를 검토하고 있습니다. 일자리는 뉴질랜드 다른 지역 사무실로 옮겨질 예정입니다. 이로 인해 지역 근로자들이 영향을 받게 됩니다.
items.title_en: ANZ may close its Dunedin contact centre
items.title_original: ANZ proposes closing its Dunedin contact centre, moving jobs elsewhere

items.raw_excerpt: The Central Weather Administration (CWA) issued extremely heavy rain advisories Friday for Keelung, parts of New Taipei along the northern coast, and the northern half of Taipei, and heavy rain advisories for other parts of northern Taiwan.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's weather agency issued extremely heavy rain advisories for Keelung, parts of New Taipei, and the northern half of Taipei. Heavy rain advisories were also issued for other parts of northern Taiwan.
items.summary_ko: 타이완 기상청이 지룽과 뉴타이베이 일부, 타이베이 북부 절반에 매우 많은 비 경보를 내렸다. 타이완 북부의 다른 지역에도 많은 비 주의보가 발령됐다.
items.title_en: Heavy rain warning for northern Taiwan
items.title_original: Heavy rain warning issued for northern, northeastern Taiwan

items.raw_excerpt: The lecture taking place on Friday is being hosted by the law faculty.
items.summary_en: Judge Madlanga will deliver the annual Rabinowitz Lecture at the University of Cape Town. The lecture is hosted by the law faculty and will take place on Friday.
items.summary_ko: 마드랑가 판사가 케이프타운 대학교 라비노위츠 강연회에서 기조연설을 합니다. 이번 강연은 법학부 주최로 금요일에 열립니다.
items.title_en: Judge Madlanga to Give Rabinowitz Lecture at UCT
items.title_ko: 마드랑가 판사, UCT 라비노위츠 강연회에서 기조연설
items.title_original: Justice Madlanga to deliver Rabinowitz Lecture at UCT

items.raw_excerpt: The National Environment Agency's daily haze advisories will include the 24-hour PSI forecast to help the public plan activities and events for the next 24 hours.
items.summary_en: Singapore's National Environment Agency will now publish daily haze advisories that include a 24-hour PSI forecast. The move is meant to help the public plan outdoor activities and events for the next 24 hours. It comes after the city-state recorded its first unhealthy 24-hour PSI reading since October 2023.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 국가환경청이 시민들이 향후 24시간 동안의 야외 활동과 행사를 계획하는 데 도움을 주기 위해 24시간 PSI 예보를 포함한 일일 연무 조언을 발표하기 시작했다. 2023년 10월 이후 처음으로 24시간 미세먼지지수가 해로운 수준을 기록한 데 따른 조치다.
items.title_en: Daily haze advisories start after first unhealthy 24-hour PSI since October 2023
items.title_ko: 2023년 10월 이후 첫 해로운 24시간 PSI 기록, 일일 연무 예보 시작
items.title_original: Daily haze advisories to start after first unhealthy 24-hour PSI reading since October 2023

items.raw_excerpt: German second-tier club VfL Osnabrück set a new bar for spectacular tifo fan displays with a fully functioning roller-coaster ahead of their game against giants Bayern Munich in the DFB-Pokal Cup.
items.summary_en: German second-tier club VfL Osnabrück fans created a fully functioning roller-coaster for their DFB-Pokal Cup match against Bayern Munich. The spectacular tifo display set a new bar for creative fan choreography in football.
items.summary_ko: 독일 2부 리그 클럽 오스나브뤼크 팬들이 포칼컵 경기장에 실제로 작동하는 롤러코스터를 만들어 눈길을 끌었다. 바이에른 뮌헨과의 경기를 앞두고 펼친 이 화려한 응원 퍼포먼스는 팬 문화의 새로운 기준을 세웠다는 평가를 받고 있다.
items.title_en: Fan-built roller-coaster sets new standard in match-day choreography
items.title_ko: 오스나브뤼크 팬, 경기장에 진짜 롤러코스터 만들어 화제
items.title_original: Fan-built roller-coaster sets new standard in match-day choreography

items.raw_excerpt: The Federal Court of Appeal has ruled in favour of a group of six Quebec mothers who were denied regular Employment Insurance (EI) benefits, after being laid off in the context of maternity and parental leaves.
items.summary_en: Six Quebec mothers were denied regular Employment Insurance benefits after being laid off during maternity and parental leave. A federal appeals court ruled in their favour.
items.summary_ko: 출산휴가와 육아휴직 중 해고된 퀘벡의 엄마 여섯 명이 정규 고용보험 수급을 거절당했습니다. 연방 항소 법원이 이 엄마들의 손을 들어주는 판결을 내렸습니다.
items.title_en: Court backs Quebec moms denied EI after maternity leave
items.title_ko: 출산휴가 중 해고된 퀘벡 엄마들, 고용보험 수급 거절에 법원 판결
items.title_original: Federal Court of Appeal rules in favour of Quebec moms denied EI benefits after maternity job loss
